routeSelectionNote: There is no election on this form. It carries no checkbox and no radio group — the only thing resembling one is the words "Male" and "Female" printed as text inside the GENDER cell, which are glyphs rather than strokes and therefore have no measured box to mark. The form's own instruction 1 says the request must be made by the requesting candidate, so on this route the person submitting the request and the subject of the record are the same person. That is read off the form rather than assumed.
